operators.name: isnan
semantics: Corresponds to reference step: mask = torch.isnan(x).
Computes element-wise NaN detection with same shape, dtype bool, and device as input.
No broadcasting, reduction, or dtype promotion; output is exactly torch.isnan.

operators.name: masked_fill
semantics: Corresponds to reference step: x = torch.masked_fill(x, mask, self.mask_value).
For each element where mask is True, output element is set to value; otherwise copied from x.
Input tensor is not modified in-place from Python perspective; output is a new contiguous tensor of same dtype and shape.
value is a scalar float (self.mask_value) and is broadcast according to torch.masked_fill scalar semantics.
Element-wise NaN check on input tensor x, output boolean tensor with same shape, device, and contiguity.
Fill positions where mask is True with scalar mask_value; other positions unchanged.
Returns a new tensor with same shape, dtype float32, and device; does not modify x in-place.
